title: GLACE mosaics — annual Sentinel-1 composites on a fixed equal-area grid
description: One mosaic per year of the GLACE composites, warped from the 10 m MGRS tiles onto ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035) at 40 m. The grid is equal-area, so an area or area-change statistic can be taken from pixel counts without a latitude correction; WebMercator, where a nominal 19.109 m pixel is about 13.2 m on the ground at 46.5 degrees north, cannot do that. Every year sits on the same fixed extent, hard-coded rather than derived from whichever tiles happen to exist, so the series stacks and differences with no alignment step. Twelve single-band analysis rasters per year, in linear units, each a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF with 256-pixel blocks and averaged internal overviews. Drawing is served separately by fourteen PMTiles archives per year, tiled on the WebMercatorQuad grid at zoom 13: each is an asset of that year's item with the visual role, named {stem}_viz.pmtiles beside the raster it renders, registered on this collection as a rel pmtiles link, and drawn by the MapLibre style this collection publishes for that year. Both products are resampled from the 10 m tiles, so neither is derived from the other. The observation-count layers become a mean rather than a count under averaging, and are described as such.

providers.name: European Space Agency / Copernicus
providers.description: Operates the Sentinel-1 mission and distributes the SLC data these composites are derived from, through the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.

providers.name: University of Zurich, Department of Geography
providers.description: Produced the composites from Copernicus Sentinel-1 SLC data and derived the annual mosaics. Maintains this catalog. The bytes are served from Source Cooperative storage; corrections go through the catalog's issue tracker.

rtc_vv.title: RTC VV annual mosaic
rtc_vv.description: Linear power. Warp averaging and the internal overviews both average in the linear domain, where the mean is physically meaningful; a decibel raster averaged the same way would give log-domain means in every overview level and silently a different quantity from the level above.

coh12_vv_qa_num.title: COH12 VV — mean contributing observations
coh12_vv_qa_num.description: A mean rather than a count: the source counts are averaged over roughly 3.6 contributing 10 m pixels per output pixel, so the value is float32 and no longer the same quantity as the tile layer it derives from.

thumbnail.title: GLACE mosaics preview
thumbnail.description: Rendered from the most recent year's coh12_rgb_viz.pmtiles archive, so the preview obeys the committed MapLibre style by construction.

style-default.title: GLACE web-map style
style-default.description: The template every published year's style is written from: the run copies it once per year as styles/{year}.json, rewriting only the year in each pmtiles:// source, in the layer ids and in the credit line. Every published web-map layer of one year, the first visible and the rest hidden. Each layer's metadata.portolan:legend carries the colour ramp and value range baked into its archive, which is where those constants live.
